details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF), in its latest World Economic Outlook published on October 13, 2026, maintained its global economic growth projection for this year at 3.1% but raised its global inflation estimates to 4.7% for 2026 and 4.1% for 2027. US inflation is expected to remain above the Federal Reserve's 2% target into 2027. The report highlights rising government bond yields and growing public debt, suggesting persistent inflationary pressures that could lead central banks to maintain tight monetary policies or raise rates further.
title: IMF Warns of Sticky Global Inflation and Debt Risks

details: The US September Consumer Price Index (CPI) report is scheduled for release on October 14, 2026, at 8:30 AM ET. Consensus forecasts anticipate headline inflation around 3.6%-3.7% year-over-year and core inflation at approximately 0.2% month-over-month. This data is the final inflation print before the Federal Reserve's October 28 interest rate decision. A stronger-than-expected inflation reading could bolster expectations for higher US interest rates, potentially pressuring Bitcoin, while a cooler reading might ease rate hike concerns.
title: US CPI Data Release Crucial for Fed's Rate Decision

details: On Monday, October 12, 2026, the US Dollar Index (DXY) climbed to an 18-month high near 102.56. This surge is largely attributed to increasing expectations that the Federal Reserve will implement another interest rate hike this year. A stronger dollar typically makes dollar-denominated assets more appealing, potentially diverting capital from riskier investments such as cryptocurrencies and high-growth technology stocks.
title: US Dollar Index Reaches 18-Month High Amid Rate Hike Expectations

details: A Bank for International Settlements (BIS) study, published on October 13, 2026, indicates that higher traditional bank deposit rates are negatively affecting stablecoin adoption. The research found that a one-basis-point increase in US deposit rates is associated with a 4.8% drop in cumulative USDC growth over a ten-week period, suggesting businesses are shifting cash to interest-bearing fiat accounts in the current rising-rate environment.
title: BIS Study Shows Rising Deposit Rates Impact Stablecoin Adoption

details: On Tuesday, October 13, 2026, Wall Street experienced mixed trading as investors reacted to a range of third-quarter bank earnings and an ongoing sell-off in semiconductor stocks. While some banks like Goldman Sachs reported strong quarters, JPMorgan Chase's earnings disappointed. Concerns over artificial intelligence (AI) spending and Chinese competition continued to weigh on chipmakers. Bitcoin, however, managed to recover above $83,400 after an earlier liquidation event.
title: Wall Street Mixed as Bank Earnings and Chip Sector Weakness Persist
